declarations.name: global_command

params.name: keywords

params.name: desc

params.name: range

params.name: weight

params.name: wear

params.name: tags

params.name: decay_pulses

params.name: container

params.name: modifiers

params.name: version

declarations.name: loot

params.name: name
params.doc: Display name shown to players.

params.name: keywords

params.name: desc

params.name: level
params.doc: Mob level.

params.name: stats

params.name: vitals
params.doc: Maximum vitals the mob starts from, built with vitals(...).

params.name: resists

params.name: skills

params.name: senses

params.name: think
params.doc: Custom AI function fn(ctx) run on each think cycle.

params.name: think_every

params.name: behaviors
params.doc: Built-in behaviors such as wander(...) or aggressive(...).

params.name: dormant_recovery
params.doc: How the mob recovers when its room wakes from dormancy.

params.name: loot
params.doc: Loot rules rolled when the mob dies, built with loot(...).

params.name: traits
params.doc: Traits defined by the world's plugins.

params.name: version
params.doc: Prototype schema version for persisted state migration.

declarations.name: package
declarations.doc: Declares the package. Must be called exactly once, in package.star.

params.name: api_version
params.doc: The script API version this package targets.

params.name: kind

params.name: title
params.doc: Human-readable title of the package.

params.name: reset_world_ticks

params.name: shared_namespaces

params.name: modifiers

params.name: expected_tombstones
params.doc: Prototype labels intentionally removed in this version, for migration checks.

params.name: migrate_noop
params.doc: Prototype labels whose version rose without needing a migrate() function.

declarations.name: region

params.name: modifiers

params.name: id

params.name: name
params.doc: Display name shown to players.

params.name: desc
params.doc: Room description shown when looking.

params.name: size

params.name: regions
params.doc: Region tags that apply their modifiers in this room.

params.doc: Tags for plugin restrictions and scripts.

params.name: flags

params.name: exits
params.doc: Exits leading out of this room, built with exit(...).

params.name: spawns
params.doc: Mob spawn rules for this room, built with spawn(...).

params.name: commands
params.doc: Room-local commands mapping verb name to fn(ctx).

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Room rules modifiers by modifier point name.

params.name: version
params.doc: Prototype schema version for persisted state migration.

params.name: id
params.doc: The skill's declaration name within the package.

params.name: kind
params.doc: Skill category, such as 'spell' or 'skill'.

params.name: cost
params.doc: Vitals spent on cast, built with vitals(...).

params.name: warmup
params.doc: Pulses of casting warmup before the skill resolves.

params.name: lag
params.doc: Recovery wait-state pulses after the skill resolves.

params.name: range
params.doc: Maximum target range.

params.name: target
params.doc: Kind of target the skill accepts.

params.name: channels
params.doc: Channels required and emitted when casting.

params.name: interrupt
params.doc: Warmup interruption rules ('damage_pct', 'stun').

params.name: attack_while_casting
params.doc: True if auto-attacks continue during warmup.

params.name: effect
params.doc: Declarative effect primitive applied when the skill resolves.

params.name: resolve
params.doc: Custom function fn(ctx) run when the skill resolves.

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags for plugin restrictions and scripts.

params.name: label
params.doc: Mob prototype label to spawn.

params.name: count
params.doc: Maximum number of instances maintained by this rule.

params.name: respawn_pulses
params.doc: Pulses before a slain mob respawns.

params.name: at_index
params.doc: Track index in the room where the mob spawns.

declarations.name: stats
declarations.doc: Numbers keyed by the world's declared stats, such as stats(str = 12). Used for stat_deltas, mob stats, and the results of encumbrance and starting_stats.

declarations.name: struct
declarations.doc: An immutable record of named fields, for example a library's exported functions: struct(start = _start).

declarations.name: vitals
declarations.doc: Numbers keyed by the world's declared vitals, such as vitals(hp = 20). Used for skill cost, mob vitals, flee(below), and the results of mitigate, move_cost, regen and starting_stats.

settings.name: messages
settings.doc: Overrides engine messages in MESSAGES.gups, by message id.

params.name: texts
params.doc: Message text by id. {name} marks a placeholder and {{ a literal brace; see the message catalog in the reference.

settings.name: module
settings.doc: Declares the world's metadata in MODULE.gups.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Engine version the world was written for.

params.name: api_version
params.doc: Script API version the world pins.

params.name: checkpoint_minutes
params.doc: Minutes between routine database checkpoints.

params.name: start_room
params.doc: Room label where new characters start.

params.name: stats
params.doc: The stats actors have, each a name or stat(name, label).

params.name: vitals
params.doc: The vitals actors have, each a name or vital(name, label).

params.name: damage_types
params.doc: The damage types of the world.

params.name: unarmed_damage_type
params.doc: The damage type of an unarmed auto-attack; one of damage_types.

params.name: channels
params.doc: Perception channels beyond sight and sound.

params.name: channel_priority
params.doc: Channels from strongest to weakest: a player is told the text of the first one they perceive. Channels left out follow, built-in ones first.

params.name: prompt
params.doc: The telnet prompt, with {vital} and {max_vital} placeholders.

params.name: plugins
params.doc: Plugin jars in plugins/<id>.jar, each pinned by its 'sha256:<hex>' checksum.

params.name: aliases
params.doc: Alias words for engine commands, such as {"l": "look"}.

params.name: prefixes
params.doc: Single characters that stand for an engine command, such as {"'": "say"}.

params.name: features
params.doc: The engine features the world uses: combat, track, skills and leveling. Fixed per database; changing it needs --wipe.

params.name: rename
params.doc: Renames engine commands, such as {"cast": "invoke"}. Aliases, prefixes and docs use the new names.

settings.name: server
settings.doc: Declares this server's settings in server.gups.

params.name: world
params.doc: Path to the course world directory.

params.name: db
params.doc: Path to the SQLite database file.

params.name: telnet
params.doc: Raw telnet listen address (host:port or :port), or None to disable.

params.name: telnet_tls
params.doc: TLS telnet listen address (host:port or :port).

params.name: https
params.doc: HTTPS and WebSocket listen address (host:port or :port).

params.doc: Loopback admin HTTP listen address (host:port).

params.name: tls_cert
params.doc: Path to the TLS certificate PEM file.

params.name: tls_key
params.doc: Path to the TLS private key PEM file.

params.name: admin_token_file
params.doc: Path to the file containing the admin bearer token.

params.name: repository
params.doc: Git repository URL or path for deploys.

params.name: deploy_branch
params.doc: Git branch deployed by the admin endpoint.

params.name: deploy_key_file
params.doc: Path to the SSH deploy key file.

params.name: open_signup
params.doc: True to allow creating player accounts without an invite code.

params.name: max_characters
params.doc: Maximum characters per account.

params.name: restriction_ladder
params.doc: Default restriction durations for @restrict.

params.name: reserved_names
params.doc: Character names players may not register.

params.name: shutdown_timeout
params.doc: Seconds a shutdown waits for the final checkpoint to be saved.

settings.name: stat
settings.doc: Declares a stat with a label, for MODULE.gups.

params.name: name
params.doc: The stat's name.

params.name: label
params.doc: The name players see.

settings.name: vital
settings.doc: Declares a vital with a label, for MODULE.gups.

params.name: name
params.doc: The vital's name.

params.name: label
params.doc: The name players see.

constants.name: DAMAGE
constants.doc: A struct of the world's declared damage types, such as DAMAGE.fire; a misspelling fails at that line.

constants.name: DIR
constants.value: struct(north = "north", east = "east", south = "south", west = "west", up = "up", down = "down", northeast = "northeast", northwest = "northwest", southeast = "southeast", southwest = "southwest")
constants.doc: Standard exit directions, such as DIR.north and DIR.west.

constants.name: MODIFIER
constants.value: struct(to_hit = "to_hit", damage = "damage", initiative = "initiative", cast_allowed = "cast_allowed", move_cost = "move_cost", regen = "regen")
constants.doc: Rules modifier points, such as MODIFIER.damage and MODIFIER.to_hit.

constants.name: SENSE
constants.doc: Perception senses (SENSE.sight, SENSE.sound, declared senses) and SENSE.all.

constants.name: SIZE
constants.doc: Track size constants for rooms: SIZE.cramped, SIZE.normal, SIZE.large.

hooks.name: before_attack
hooks.doc: Fires before an attack swing; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: before_cast
hooks.doc: Fires before casting begins; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: before_close
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor starts closing a door or container; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: before_drop
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor drops an item; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: before_enter
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor enters the room; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: before_exit
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor leaves the room through an exit; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: before_get
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor picks up an item; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: before_lock
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor starts locking a door or container; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: before_open
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor starts opening a door or container; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: before_unlock
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor starts unlocking a door or container; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: before_use
hooks.doc: Fires before an actor uses an item; return ctx.deny(msg) to veto.

hooks.name: on_cast
hooks.doc: Fires after a skill resolves.

hooks.name: on_cast_start
hooks.doc: Fires when a skill enters casting warmup.

hooks.name: on_close
hooks.doc: Fires after a door or container is closed. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: on_combat_tick
hooks.doc: Fires once per combat round on each fighting mob and its equipped items.

hooks.name: on_damage
hooks.doc: Fires when an actor takes damage.

hooks.name: on_death
hooks.doc: Fires when an actor dies.

hooks.name: on_drop
hooks.doc: Fires after an actor drops an item.

hooks.name: on_enter
hooks.doc: Fires after an actor enters the room.

hooks.name: on_exit
hooks.doc: Fires after an actor leaves the room through an exit.

hooks.name: on_get
hooks.doc: Fires after an actor picks up an item.

hooks.name: on_give
hooks.doc: Fires when an actor gives an item to another actor.

hooks.name: on_load
hooks.doc: Fires when a room is created on world load or reload, or when a mob or item is loaded.

hooks.name: on_lock
hooks.doc: Fires after a door or container is locked. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: on_open
hooks.doc: Fires after a door or container is opened. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: on_perceive
hooks.doc: Fires on a mob when `rules.can_perceive` lets it notice an event on a channel, in its room or carried to it from farther away.

hooks.name: on_reset
hooks.doc: Fires on a room when its zone resets.

hooks.name: on_say
hooks.doc: Fires when an actor says something aloud in the room.

hooks.name: on_spawn
hooks.doc: Fires when a mob or item is freshly spawned, or on a room when a spawn rule fires.

hooks.name: on_tell
hooks.doc: Fires on a mob when an actor sends it a tell.

hooks.name: on_tick
hooks.doc: Fires on each world tick while simulated.

hooks.name: on_unlock
hooks.doc: Fires after a door or container is unlocked. For a door ctx.direction is set and ctx.item is None; for a container it is the other way around.

hooks.name: on_use
hooks.doc: Fires when an actor uses an item.

hooks.name: on_wake
hooks.doc: Fires when an entity wakes from dormancy as the reality bubble reaches its room.

ctx.name: ctx
ctx.doc: The context of one hook invocation.

fields.name: actor
fields.doc: The actor performing the action, or the damage/kill source.

fields.name: affect
fields.doc: The affect, for affect on_tick and on_expire.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: The total of the vital losses a damage event caused, for on_damage.

fields.name: args
fields.doc: A command's argument text, or a timer's keyword arguments as a dict.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: For on_perceive: the channel the event travelled on, such as 'sound'.

fields.name: cost
fields.doc: For on_perceive: how much the event weakened on its way here; 0 in the room it happened in.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: The movement direction name, for enter and exit hooks.

fields.name: elapsed_pulses
fields.doc: Pulses spent dormant, for on_wake.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: For on_perceive: 'say', 'emote', 'shout', 'combat_start', 'combat', 'death', 'enter', 'exit', 'open', 'close', 'lock', 'unlock' or the event a script passed to ctx.emit.

fields.name: from_room
fields.doc: The room the actor came from, for enter hooks.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: For on_perceive: the event's strength where it happened.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The item being picked up, dropped, used or given.

fields.name: losses
fields.doc: The vital losses behind amount, as vitals(...), for on_damage.

fields.name: proposals
fields.doc: For think: behavior proposals, best first.

fields.name: pulse
fields.doc: Game time.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why the affect ended, 'expired' or 'removed', for affect on_expire.

fields.name: rng
fields.doc: The seeded random number generator.

fields.name: room
fields.doc: The room the event happens in.

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The hook's owner.

fields.name: skill
fields.doc: The skill being cast, for before_cast, on_cast_start and on_cast.

fields.name: source_room
fields.doc: For on_perceive: the room the event happened in.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The target actor, or the target item of use and item skills.

fields.name: targets
fields.doc: Opponents, for on_combat_tick.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Spoken text, for on_say and on_tell.

fields.name: to_room
fields.doc: The room the actor is going to, for exit hooks.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The damage type, for on_damage.

fields.name: via_exit
fields.doc: For on_perceive: this mob's own exit toward the event, or None for its own room.

fields.name: weapon
fields.doc: The weapon used in an attack, or None for unarmed.

methods.name: act
methods.doc: Queues a command line for a mob, exactly as if it typed it.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: command_line
params.doc: The command line, as a player would type it.

methods.name: act_advance
methods.doc: Queues one step along the room track toward target for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor or item in the same room to step toward.

methods.name: act_attack
methods.doc: Queues an attack against target for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to attack.

methods.name: act_cast
methods.doc: Queues casting a skill for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: skill
params.doc: Skill label to cast.

params.name: target
params.doc: Target actor or item, or None for the skill's default target.

methods.name: act_move
methods.doc: Queues a move through an exit for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit to take.

methods.name: act_retreat
methods.doc: Queues one step along the room track away from target (or toward the room back) for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor or item to step away from, or None to step toward the back of the room.

methods.name: after
methods.doc: Calls fn(ctx, **args) on this hook's owner after some pulses. fn must be a top-level function; args must be storable.

params.name: pulses
params.doc: Pulses to wait, at least 1.

params.name: fn
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx, **args) to call.

params.name: args
params.doc: Keyword arguments passed to fn; values must be storable (int, str, bool, list or dict).

methods.name: allies_near
methods.doc: Actors of the same side (players with players, mobs with mobs) within a band who are not fighting actor.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor whose allies are wanted.

params.name: band
params.doc: Maximum distance: 'melee', 'near' or 'far'.

methods.name: apply_affect
methods.doc: Attaches a timed buff or debuff; re-applying a name replaces it.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to receive the affect.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name; applying the same name again replaces the existing affect.

params.name: duration
params.doc: Duration in pulses.

params.name: stat_deltas
params.doc: Stat adjustments while the affect lasts, built with stats(...).

params.name: flags
params.doc: Flags the affect grants, such as 'no_regen'.

params.name: tick_every
params.doc: Pulses between on_tick calls, or None for no ticking.

params.name: on_tick
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called every tick_every pulses.

params.name: on_expire
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called when the affect expires or is removed.

params.name: expire_msg
params.doc: Text sent to the target when the affect ends.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Rules modifiers active while the affect lasts, by modifier point name.

params.name: sense_deltas
params.doc: Sense score changes by channel while the affect lasts.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Cancels one of this owner's timers; True if it was pending.

params.name: timer_id
params.doc: Timer id returned by ctx.after.

methods.name: clear_active
methods.doc: Removes a set_active reason from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason given to set_active.

methods.name: clear_anchor
methods.doc: Removes a set_anchor reason from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason given to set_anchor.

methods.name: close_door
methods.doc: Closes an open door in direction dir.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: damage
methods.doc: Deals damage directly to one vital (no to-hit roll, no mitigation); fires on_damage with just that loss.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to damage.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Points of damage.

params.name: type
params.doc: A declared damage type, such as DAMAGE.fire.

params.name: vital
params.doc: The declared vital that loses the points.

params.name: source
params.doc: Actor credited with the damage, or None.

methods.name: del_attr
methods.doc: Deletes an attribute key from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; unprefixed keys are in your package's namespace.

methods.name: deny
methods.doc: Vetoes the action; return it from a before_* hook.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Text shown to the actor whose action is refused.

methods.name: destroy
methods.doc: Removes an item and everything inside it.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to remove from the world.

methods.name: echo
methods.doc: Sends text to everyone in a room, except the actors in exclude.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, to send the text to.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text to send.

params.name: exclude
params.doc: Actors who don't receive the text.

methods.name: emit
methods.doc: Raises a perceivable event on a channel. It spreads through nearby rooms from room, weakening on the way; actors who can perceive it hear or see it through on_perceive and rules.perceive_message.

params.name: channel
params.doc: A built-in or declared channel name.

params.name: event
params.doc: Event name that on_perceive hooks see.

params.name: intensity
params.doc: Strength at the origin; 0 or less emits nothing.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text that goes with the event.

exports.name: advance_lag
exports.doc: Recovery lag in pulses after advance. ctx.target is the actor approached; ctx.band is the band after the step.

exports.name: can_perceive
exports.doc: Whether ctx.actor, a candidate listener, notices the event. Asked for every simulated actor in a room the event reaches, the room it happened in included, except the actor who caused it.

exports.name: carry_limit
exports.doc: Maximum weight the actor can carry without encumbrance.

exports.name: cast_allowed
exports.doc: Returns None if casting is allowed, or ctx.deny(msg) to refuse.

exports.name: condition
exports.doc: The actor's life state: 'ok', 'incapacitated' or 'dead'. Asked after any change to one of its vitals and at each world tick.

exports.name: damage
exports.doc: Raw attack damage before modifiers and mitigation.

exports.name: door_intensity
exports.doc: The sound intensity of ctx.action ('open', 'close', 'lock' or 'unlock') on a door (ctx.exit) or container (ctx.item); 0 or less is silent.

exports.name: encumbrance
exports.doc: Stat deltas applied while the actor carries more than carry_limit.

exports.name: equipment_slots
exports.doc: Equipment slot names in display and modifier evaluation order.

exports.name: flee_chance
exports.doc: Chance in percent for a fleeing actor to escape through an exit.

exports.name: flee_fail_lag
exports.doc: Recovery lag after a failed flee, whether the roll failed or the exit refused. ctx.target is None.

exports.name: get_lag
exports.doc: Wait-state pulses for picking up an item at band, or None if out of reach.

exports.name: initiative
exports.doc: Combat round initiative score; higher acts first.

exports.name: interrupt_check
exports.doc: True if a damage event with this total loss interrupts an in-progress cast.

exports.name: mitigate
exports.doc: The vital losses that amount damage of type causes the defender.

exports.name: move_cost
exports.doc: The vitals spent when leaving a room.

exports.name: on_level_up
exports.doc: Stat and vital deltas awarded when an actor reaches a new level, as a struct(stats = stats(...), max = vitals(...), current = vitals(...)) or None.

exports.name: on_player_death
exports.doc: Player death outcome as {'respawn': label, 'vitals': vitals(...), 'xp_loss': int}; vitals sets the respawned character's current vitals.

exports.name: perceive_message
exports.doc: What a player in another room is told about an event they can_perceive, or None for nothing. The room of the event is told as it happens and never asked.

exports.name: regen
exports.doc: What each vital gains per world tick; negative values lose.

exports.name: retreat_check
exports.doc: Chance in percent to retreat along the track when pinned in melee.

exports.name: retreat_fail_lag
exports.doc: Recovery lag after a failed retreat_check. ctx.target is the pinner; ctx.band is "melee".

exports.name: retreat_lag
exports.doc: Recovery lag after a successful retreat. ctx.target is the threat; ctx.band is the band after the step.

exports.name: sense_cost
exports.doc: What a perceivable event on ctx.channel loses crossing ctx.exit into ctx.room, one hop toward the listeners. The price is added to the event's cost; a negative price blocks the hop. ctx.actor is None.

exports.name: starting_stats
exports.doc: Numbers for a new character or spawned mob, as struct(stats = stats(...), max = vitals(...), current = vitals(...)); every field is optional and a current value left out equals the maximum.

exports.name: to_hit
exports.doc: Hit chance in percent before modifiers.

exports.name: xp_for_kill
exports.doc: Experience points awarded to actor for slaying target.

exports.name: xp_to_level
exports.doc: The total XP at which the given level ends.

modifier_points.name: cast_allowed
modifier_points.doc: Returns None to allow casting, or ctx.deny(msg) to refuse.

modifier_points.name: move_cost
modifier_points.doc: Adjusts the vitals spent for leaving a room.

modifier_points.name: regen
modifier_points.doc: Adjusts the per-tick regeneration of each vital.

harness.name: diagnostic
harness.doc: A read-only diagnostic entry from w.diagnostics().

fields.name: file
fields.doc: The Starlark file where the error occurred, or None.

fields.name: hook
fields.doc: The hook, command or timer name, or None.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Diagnostic category, such as 'script_error', 'step_limit' or 'quarantine'.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The prototype label involved, or None.

fields.name: line
fields.doc: 1-based source line number, or None.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Human-readable diagnostic message.

fields.name: package
fields.doc: The package the diagnostic was charged to, or None.

fields.name: pulse
fields.doc: Game pulse when the diagnostic was recorded.

harness.name: p
harness.doc: A test player: its view fields plus do(line) and output().

fields.name: affects
fields.doc: Active timed affects on this actor.

fields.name: attrs
fields.doc: Custom attributes; your package's own keys by short name.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Base stat values, without affects, equipment or encumbrance: base.dex.

fields.name: carried_weight
fields.doc: Weight of everything carried and worn.

fields.name: casting
fields.doc: The skill being cast, or None.

fields.name: choices
fields.doc: Chosen character creation options by choice id: a dict, empty for mobs.

fields.name: condition
fields.doc: 'ok', 'incapacitated' or 'dead', as the rules last decided.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Flags from affects and traits, including those worn items apply, sorted.

fields.name: home_room
fields.doc: A mob's home room label; None for players.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The entity's id.

fields.name: in_world
fields.doc: False once the actor has died (mobs) or quit.

fields.name: is_casting
fields.doc: True while the actor is in casting warmup.

fields.name: is_player
fields.doc: True for a player, False for a mob.

fields.name: keywords
fields.doc: Words that match this actor when targeting.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The prototype label.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: The actor's level.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The entity's display name.

fields.name: recall_room
fields.doc: A player's recall room label; None for mobs.

fields.name: resists
fields.doc: Damage resistance percentage by declared damage type: resists.fire.

fields.name: room
fields.doc: The room the actor is currently in.

fields.name: senses
fields.doc: Effective sense score on every channel, with traits, affects and equipment applied: senses['sound']. 0 senses nothing on that channel.

fields.name: skills
fields.doc: Skill label to proficiency (0-100).

fields.name: track_index
fields.doc: Position along the room's 1D track.

fields.name: traits
fields.doc: Sorted names of the known traits the actor carries.

fields.name: wait_state
fields.doc: Recovery pulses left.

fields.name: xp
fields.doc: Current experience points.

methods.name: band_of
methods.doc: 'melee', 'near' or 'far' to another actor or item in the same room; None elsewhere.

params.name: other
params.doc: Actor or item in the same room.

methods.name: below_zero_since
methods.doc: The pulse the vital last dropped below 0, or None while it is 0 or more.

params.name: vital
params.doc: A declared vital.

methods.name: do
methods.doc: Enters a command line, runs pulses until the player's queued actions and casts are done, and returns the output since the last do() or output().

params.name: line
params.doc: Command line, as the player would type it.

methods.name: equipped
methods.doc: The item in an equipment slot, or None.

params.name: slot
params.doc: Equipment slot name, such as 'wield' or 'body'.

methods.name: fighting
methods.doc: Actors engaged with this one.

methods.name: has_flag
methods.doc: True if an affect, trait or a worn item gives this flag, such as 'no_regen'.

params.name: flag
params.doc: Flag name, such as 'no_regen'.

methods.name: has_item
methods.doc: Whether the actor carries or wears an item of this prototype.

params.name: label
params.doc: Item prototype label.

methods.name: has_trait
methods.doc: True if the actor carries this trait.

params.name: name
params.doc: Trait name.

methods.name: inventory
methods.doc: Carried items (not equipment).

methods.name: output
methods.doc: Output received since the last do() or output().

harness.name: t
harness.doc: The test context: makes worlds and checks results.

methods.name: contains
methods.doc: Fails unless a string contains a substring, or a list or dict contains an item.

params.name: container
params.doc: String, list or dict to search.

params.name: item
params.doc: Substring, element or key to find.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: eq
methods.doc: Fails unless actual == expected. An entity view equals its label, so t.eq(p.room, ':hall') works.

params.name: actual
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: expected
params.doc: Expected value.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: fail
methods.doc: Fails the test.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Failure message.

methods.name: false
methods.doc: Fails unless the value is falsy.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: ne
methods.doc: Fails if actual == unexpected.

params.name: actual
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: unexpected
params.doc: Value it must not equal.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: not_contains
methods.doc: Fails if a string contains a substring, or a list or dict contains an item.

params.name: container
params.doc: String, list or dict to search.

params.name: item
params.doc: Substring, element or key that must be absent.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: true
methods.doc: Fails unless the value is truthy.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: world
methods.doc: A fresh headless world with the given packages (default: this test's package) and the rules package. The `load` argument is spelled `packages`, since load is a Starlark keyword. rules names another rules package to use instead of //rules. bubble=True keeps a reality bubble, so only rooms near players are simulated; by default every room is.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Random seed for the world.

params.name: packages
params.doc: Packages to load, or None for this test's package.

params.name: rules
params.doc: Rules package label such as //rules_alt, or None for //rules.

params.name: bubble
params.doc: True to simulate only rooms near players; by default every room is simulated.

fields.name: pulse
fields.doc: Game time.

methods.name: damage
methods.doc: Damages one vital of an actor by amount, or by pct of that vital's maximum. Fires on_damage; death is processed at once.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to damage.

params.name: vital
params.doc: The declared vital that loses the points.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Points of damage, or None to use pct.

params.name: pct
params.doc: Percentage of the vital's maximum, or None to use amount.

params.name: type
params.doc: A declared damage type, or None for the unarmed type.

methods.name: diagnostics
methods.doc: Script and engine problems logged so far.

methods.name: get_attr
methods.doc: Reads an attribute directly. Unprefixed keys are in the test package's namespace.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key.

params.name: default
params.doc: Value returned when the key is absent.

methods.name: grant_trait
methods.doc: Grants a trait to an actor, returning the refusal message or None.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor to grant the trait to.

params.name: name
params.doc: The trait name.

methods.name: quarantined
methods.doc: Packages currently quarantined.

methods.name: remove_trait
methods.doc: Removes a granted trait from an actor, returning the refusal message or None.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor to remove the trait from.

params.name: name
params.doc: The trait name.

methods.name: room
methods.doc: A view of a room.

params.name: label
params.doc: Room label.

methods.name: run
methods.doc: Advances game time.

params.name: pulses
params.doc: Pulses to advance.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.doc: Sets an attribute directly. Unprefixed keys are in the test package's namespace.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value to store, or None to delete the key.

methods.name: set_choices
methods.doc: Changes or removes answers for a player, exactly as a plugin's setChoices does.

params.name: player
params.doc: The player to modify.

params.name: changes
params.doc: Map of choice id to option id, with None removing an answer.

methods.name: spawn
methods.doc: Spawns a mob or item and returns its view.

params.name: label
params.doc: Mob or item prototype label.

params.name: at
params.doc: Room label or view, actor, or container item.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index when spawning into a room.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number to spawn; more than 1 returns a list.

methods.name: spawn_player
methods.doc: Adds a connected player and returns its handle. The numbers come from rules.starting_stats; vitals and stats override them.

params.name: name
params.doc: Player name.

params.name: at
params.doc: Starting room label.

params.name: level
params.doc: Player level.

params.name: vitals
params.doc: Starting and maximum vitals, built with vitals(...), or None for the rules'.

params.name: stats
params.doc: Base stats, built with stats(...), or None for the rules'.

params.name: skills
params.doc: Known skills mapping skill label to proficiency, or None.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index in the starting room.

params.name: choices
params.doc: Character creation answers, or None.

methods.name: trace
methods.doc: Records every hook and verb call; shown when the test fails.

params.name: on
params.doc: True to start recording, False to stop.
